mapper.insert: INSERT INTO circle_follows (user_id, circle_id) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{circle_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM circle_follows WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND circle_id = #{circle_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_follows WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND circle_id = #{circle_id}

SELECT c.circle_id, c.name, c.logo_url, c.description, COALESCE(ac.album_count, 0) AS album_count, c.member_count FROM circle_follows cf JOIN circles c ON cf.circle_id = c.circle_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM album_circles ac2 WHERE ac2.circle_id = c.circle_id ) ac ON true WHERE cf.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY cf.created_at DESC
